name: Existing harness and provider built-ins
rationale: Keep the current model, effort, native login, permissions, compaction, tool discovery and cache as the comparator. No optimizer installation is required.
license_status: Provider terms and the chosen harness license apply; no subscription credential redistribution.
evidence_scope: First-party documentation and prior pinned harness-source inspection. No authenticated cross-harness smoke test in this scan.
control_surface: Native context assembly, tool discovery and provider billing.
best_tasks: Every task.
marginal_savings: Avoid unnecessary schema loading; native caching discounts repeated prefixes rather than removing logical input tokens.
adoption_and_rollback: Inventory effective route and built-ins before changing anything. Keep a settings snapshot; restore only changed project/session settings. Never rewrite opaque provider state.
authority_maturity: First-party maintained capabilities; availability is route and version specific.

name: Focused reads and exact coverage
rationale: Start with exact filenames, IDs, source-side fields and relevant spans, not a new vector database. Full-reading and all-record requirements override top-k selection.
license_status: Use existing permitted tools. ripgrep is dual MIT/Unlicense.
evidence_scope: Source/README inspection of lexical search; method recommendation, not a measured task-saving estimate.
control_surface: Source query and explicit read-tool inputs.
best_tasks: Known-document lookup, repository exploration, research.
marginal_savings: Less irrelevant material enters context and fewer repeated searches occur.
adoption_and_rollback: Use existing read/search tools. Preserve source versions, qualifiers and coverage. Widen or restore full sources on missing evidence; remove optional search guidance to revert.
authority_maturity: Established lexical tooling; search success alone does not establish semantic completeness. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Deterministic data execution
rationale: Parse, paginate, join, count, deduplicate and generate requested artifacts with existing code or SQL; ask the model to interpret verified results.
license_status: Existing runtime terms; SQLite core is public domain; optional engines have separate dependencies.
evidence_scope: Official SQL documentation and native code-execution documentation; no savings benchmark run here.
control_surface: Native approved execution tool or source database.
best_tasks: Spreadsheets, paginated APIs, finance calculations, report generation.
marginal_savings: Avoid serial model-mediated row handling and repeated generation of unchanged data.
adoption_and_rollback: Use read-only snapshots first. Reconcile page and row counts, nulls, multiplicity and totals; retain source and output artifacts. Revert to the existing query/script. Never replay external writes.
authority_maturity: Mature deterministic mechanism; calculation over all rows is not semantic review of every row.

name: Versioned exact reuse
rationale: Reuse a verified read or deterministic result only when parameters, source versions, freshness and current authorization match. Matching question text alone is insufficient.
license_status: No new required library. Existing store and retention terms apply.
evidence_scope: Method recommendation grounded in exact-cache implementation and provider documentation; no hit-rate promise.
control_surface: Application read cache, artifact store or unchanged source snapshot.
best_tasks: Recurring reports, stable transformations, unchanged repository reads.
marginal_savings: Avoid an entire redundant tool/model operation on valid hits; lookup and invalidation still cost work.
adoption_and_rollback: Reuse existing artifacts keyed by exact dependencies and principal. On corrections, revocation or refresh, invalidate and reread. Disable cache to revert; never cache permission or a write confirmation.
authority_maturity: Exact reuse is established; dependency completeness remains the integrator’s responsibility.

name: Ponytail-inspired complete coding discipline
rationale: Adapt reuse, native-feature-first and smallest-complete-change guidance, not upstream scope reduction or one-check limits. Preserve every required feature, security boundary and project test.
license_status: MIT upstream; independently written guidance here, no copied skill text.
evidence_scope: Author real-agent benchmark: 12 features, Haiku 4.5, four runs per arm; 22% reported token reduction. Feature functionality was not fully exercised.
control_surface: Task-scoped coding instructions, not model/provider routing.
best_tasks: Feature delivery, fixes and refactors.
marginal_savings: Less speculative code generation and repeated deliberation or scaffolding.
adoption_and_rollback: Load short adapted rules only for the coding task. Verify full acceptance and existing tests; remove the added rules to revert. Do not auto-install the upstream full/ultra plugin.
authority_maturity: Popular project with a real-agent author artifact and acknowledged benchmark corrections; not a universal quality guarantee. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Aider repository maps and native edit formats
rationale: For existing Aider users, keep its map and model-appropriate patch format. Do not install a second map simply to duplicate the overview.
license_status: Apache-2.0 code; tree-sitter grammars and model-provider access are separate.
evidence_scope: Official docs and repomap source: graph ranking under a token budget, with omissions and dynamic expansion. No incremental whole-task percentage claimed.
control_surface: Existing harness repository map and edit format.
best_tasks: Unknown code architecture and focused changes.
marginal_savings: A ranked structural map replaces whole-repository dumps; patches avoid regenerating unchanged files.
adoption_and_rollback: Use native settings and existing map. Read full edit targets and callers; restore the prior map/edit setting if navigation or patch retries regress.
authority_maturity: Established coding harness; maps orient rather than prove exhaustive code review.

name: RTK
rationale: Use explicit, narrowly selected repetitive command filters only when the native output is still noisy. Never filter complete diffs or forensic records by default.
license_status: Apache-2.0; check chosen release binary and dependencies.
evidence_scope: README, tee/tracking source and benchmark inspection. Up to 90% concerns eligible Bash output; the inspected counter estimates bytes/4, not provider receipts.
control_surface: Explicit shell wrapper; automatic input rewrites depend on the harness adapter.
best_tasks: Repetitive test/build/status output.
marginal_savings: Remove progress and repeated output before subsequent model ingestion.
adoption_and_rollback: Pilot explicit invocations in one project, retain raw stdout/stderr and exit code independently. Bypass RTK to revert. Its bounded tee is not a durable archive; never rerun a write for raw output.
authority_maturity: Established command-specific implementation and public tests; large payload savings are not end-to-end quality evidence. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Serena
rationale: Add only if the current harness lacks healthy symbol navigation. Native diagnostics alone are not equivalent to definition/reference lookup.
license_status: MIT core; language-server licenses/downloads and optional paid JetBrains backend require separate checks.
evidence_scope: README, running guide and symbol-tools source inspected; no task-wide savings benchmark reproduced.
control_surface: Per-project MCP symbol lookup and edit tools.
best_tasks: Cross-file coding and references.
marginal_savings: Retrieve relevant symbols rather than repeatedly reading entire files.
adoption_and_rollback: Use a scoped stdio server and required language server; inspect read/edit permissions. Remove its MCP registration and stop its process to revert; code edits still need normal review.
authority_maturity: Mature language-intelligence integration; dynamic imports, reflection and generated code need additional investigation. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: TOON
rationale: Compare against compact JSON and typed CSV before selecting TOON for regular records. Keep actual protocol schemas and signed payloads unchanged.
license_status: MIT; validate runtime numeric precision and chosen encoder dependencies.
evidence_scope: Encoder source and author retrieval benchmark: 244 questions across four models; about 14.45% fewer format tokens than compact JSON, not full-task savings.
control_surface: Explicit model-visible data serialization.
best_tasks: Uniform JSON arrays and repetitive keyed records.
marginal_savings: Share field names instead of repeating them per record.
adoption_and_rollback: Encode a retained copy, round-trip types/nulls/IDs/order and count the target tokenizer plus format instructions. Revert by returning the original compact JSON.
authority_maturity: Published format and implementation; value round-trip does not guarantee model comprehension, and nested data can grow. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: QMD by tobi
rationale: A practical local index for recurring notes/docs when lexical search is insufficient; not a replacement for a required full read.
license_status: MIT code. Node/Bun and node-llama-cpp dependencies; GGUF embedding/reranking/expansion weights need their own terms and download approval.
evidence_scope: README and MCP/store source inspected. Bench fixtures exist; no independently reproduced whole-task saving for this repository.
control_surface: Local CLI or scoped MCP index; lexical, vector and reranking modes.
best_tasks: Repeated search across a permitted documentation collection.
marginal_savings: Reuse an index and retrieve exact relevant spans instead of resending a corpus; neural stages add local compute.
adoption_and_rollback: Start lexical-only on a small explicit collection. Check exclusions, stale entries and retrieval counts; multi_get has size limits. Remove the MCP entry and index configuration to revert, retaining original files. Avoid unauthenticated shared HTTP.
authority_maturity: Substantial adoption and source-visible retrieval controls; collection filters are not an authorization system. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: LlamaIndex
rationale: Use when it is already the application’s retrieval owner or real connectors/pipelines are needed; not a mandatory agent install.
license_status: MIT core; separately licensed integrations, embedding weights, parsers and paid LlamaCloud services.
evidence_scope: README plus BM25 retriever/query-engine source inspected. Top-k and metadata filters exist; framework support does not establish recall or savings.
control_surface: Application retriever, node selection, metadata filters and reranking.
best_tasks: Existing RAG applications with governed sources.
marginal_savings: Return fewer irrelevant chunks; persistent indices avoid repeated ingestion.
adoption_and_rollback: In a project environment, select core and only required integrations; explicitly select the existing model and embedder. Test ACL/freshness/answer-span recall, then restore the prior pipeline to revert.
authority_maturity: Established framework with extensive integrations; turnkey examples can introduce extra models and service charges. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Haystack
rationale: Alternative to LlamaIndex for an existing application, not an additional retrieval layer.
license_status: Apache-2.0 core; integration/model terms and commercial Enterprise Platform are separate; review documented telemetry.
evidence_scope: README and BM25 source inspected. Runtime filters default to replacing initialization filters; no default tenant-boundary guarantee.
control_surface: Retrieval/ranking/pipeline components and approved application tools.
best_tasks: RAG, document processing and existing Python pipelines.
marginal_savings: Source filtering and retrieval selection can reduce irrelevant input; repeated indexing has overhead.
adoption_and_rollback: Pilot a project-local pipeline with fixed source and authorization constraints; test filter replacement and telemetry policy. Restore the previous pipeline/config to revert.
authority_maturity: Established deepset project with paid support/platform options; query filters must never be allowed to remove required ACL constraints. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: DuckDB
rationale: Choose only when existing Python/SQL tools do not comfortably handle the local analytical data; do not add a model to calculate totals.
license_status: MIT core; extensions and remote-file access need separate approval.
evidence_scope: Official SQL docs and repository/license inspected; no LLM token benchmark or installed-engine trial here.
control_surface: Local analytical SQL over authorized source files.
best_tasks: Large CSV/Parquet joins, aggregates and reports.
marginal_savings: Model sees verified results and exceptions, not every row repeatedly.
adoption_and_rollback: Use a scoped environment and read-only input copies; declare types and reconcile full row counts. Revert to the former query/script and retain original datasets.
authority_maturity: Established analytical engine; numerical exactness and SQL selection must match the task. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: tiktoken
rationale: Useful for eligible OpenAI text encodings; provider usage receipts remain authoritative for billing and full requests.
license_status: MIT code; verify the exact encoding/model mapping.
evidence_scope: Tokenizer API/source inspected, not an arbitrary-provider metering standard.
control_surface: Offline tokenizer for a specified text payload.
best_tasks: Comparing compact encodings and eligible output filters.
marginal_savings: Does not save tokens itself; rejects transformations that only reduce bytes.
adoption_and_rollback: Use the encoding for the actual model and count explanatory overhead. Stop using the comparator or remove the local dependency to revert; do not report text counts as complete multimodal billing.
authority_maturity: First-party tokenizer; special tokens, hidden envelopes and non-OpenAI tokenizers differ. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: ccusage by ryoppippi
rationale: Use supported local logs to inspect task/session totals before adding a proxy. Dollar columns may be API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges.
license_status: MIT app license; root LICENSE is a pointer, not the full grant. Inspect the selected package and log access.
evidence_scope: Current README, cost-mode docs and Rust cost implementation inspected. Display mode uses zero for absent cost; absence is not evidence of free usage.
control_surface: Read-only analysis of supported local usage logs.
best_tasks: Native subscription and API coding-session accounting.
marginal_savings: No direct reduction; reveals repeated work, cached input and expensive trajectories.
adoption_and_rollback: Choose the correct adapter, time window and cost mode; reconcile sample events to logs and the provider account. Remove the optional reader to revert; retain original logs.
authority_maturity: Established local analysis project, now with a unified CLI; log fields and adapters are version dependent. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Headroom
rationale: Specialist option for a controlled application or explicit tool boundary, not the default transparent proxy. Disable effort routing and reject sampling for exhaustive work.
license_status: Apache-2.0 core with notices; optional dependency and model-weight closure requires review.
evidence_scope: README, SmartCrusher source, limitations and four-scenario seeded payload artifact inspected. Tool-content tokens only, not complete task quality.
control_surface: SDK transformation, MCP tool or optional gateway; exact capabilities depend on configuration.
best_tasks: Repetitive logs, structured observations and exploration.
marginal_savings: Select/encode observations before model input; sample-based paths are lossy and restore costs matter.
adoption_and_rollback: Prefer an explicit eligible new-output path. Verify raw recovery, no effort changes, telemetry and unchanged endpoint. Bypass that transform to revert; proxy trials require restoring original provider settings too.
authority_maturity: Extensive source and benchmarks; the large popularity signal does not override documented lossiness or unmeasured cases. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: context-mode
rationale: Optional user-installed execution/indexing tool when built-ins are inadequate. Offloading is not proof that the agent reviewed omitted content.
license_status: Elastic License 2.0 source available; substantial hosted/managed-service use needs separate permission. Not a permissive managed-service dependency.
evidence_scope: README/license, Codex hook and v0.4 benchmark artifact inspected. 198337 to 12609 bytes over 13 examples; retrieval receipts are not finished answers.
control_surface: Explicit execution/search MCP tools; lifecycle hooks vary by harness.
best_tasks: Large tool outputs and searchable session material.
marginal_savings: Keep bulk execution/index contents outside the prompt, returning results or selected spans.
adoption_and_rollback: Scope the instance and verify execution permissions, retention and restart recovery. Remove its MCP/hooks and restore raw tools to revert; export needed evidence before session cleanup.
authority_maturity: Source-visible integrations and byte fixtures; Codex event capture is not equivalent to output replacement. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: LiteLLM
rationale: Consider for an existing approved API application needing central metering, budgets or routing. For this initial API-governance recommendation, leave existing native subscription routes unchanged; provider-specific OAuth support and permission must be assessed separately.
license_status: MIT outside enterprise; audited proxy extra includes litellm-enterprise. Commercial terms and exact dependency closure are separate.
evidence_scope: README, license and pyproject inspected; gateway/provider support and accounting, not a universal token-reduction benchmark.
control_surface: Approved application endpoint/SDK and optionally request logging.
best_tasks: Teams already operating API applications.
marginal_savings: Budgets prevent unintended work; exact hits can avoid inference; cheaper routing changes price, not inherently token count.
adoption_and_rollback: Reuse the existing gateway if any. Snapshot endpoint/model/auth mapping, disable unapproved fallbacks and semantic cache, test tools/streaming/usage and privacy. Restore original endpoint and revoke trial keys to revert.
authority_maturity: Established maintained gateway/observability project. Evaluate exact editions and protocols, not logo counts; no cross-provider quality guarantee. GitHub adoption/activity snapshot is recorded as a screening signal, not a quality score.

name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
rationale: A managed option for approved API workloads, especially repeated static requests. Do not replace the existing route solely for a cache checkbox.
license_status: Hosted service terms and pricing apply; not an OSS license grant.
evidence_scope: Official caching docs inspected: default key includes provider, endpoint, model, auth header and full request body; HIT/MISS is observable.
control_surface: Approved gateway request cache and account settings.
best_tasks: Static repeated API requests.
marginal_savings: A valid exact hit avoids a provider call; native prefix caching does not.
adoption_and_rollback: Scope one approved app, set retention/freshness and preserve key isolation. Verify HIT/MISS plus a changed-source MISS. Disable caching, purge relevant entries and restore direct endpoint to revert.
authority_maturity: First-party commercial docs; defaults cannot encode every external data dependency and custom keys can weaken isolation.

name: Provider Batch APIs
rationale: For eligible asynchronous API work already approved for delayed execution. Keep selected models and exact work; this is not token compression.
license_status: Provider API agreement and data-retention rules, separate from consumer subscription seats.
evidence_scope: OpenAI first-party Batch guide: 50% lower API cost for eligible batch processing with a 24-hour turnaround; not fewer logical tokens.
control_surface: Native provider asynchronous request scheduling.
best_tasks: Nonurgent independent extraction or classification jobs.
marginal_savings: Lower price per eligible token; may reduce orchestration overhead, but no inherent token cut.
adoption_and_rollback: Use existing batch tooling with explicit request IDs, result/error reconciliation and no duplicate writes. Stop submitting new batches; reconcile in-flight jobs before returning to synchronous requests.
authority_maturity: First-party supported route, but availability, quotas and turnaround must fit the real task.

name: LLMLingua / LLMLingua-2

license_status: MIT code; exact checkpoint licenses differ (MIT and Apache-2.0 cards inspected); approve weights, tokenizer and local compute.
evidence_scope: Primary papers and checkpoint/source evidence. Prompt-level compression and task-specific accuracy losses, not whole-agent quality equivalence.
control_surface: Local helper model prunes prompt tokens.
best_tasks: Long retrieved prose outside protected instructions and exact-value work.
marginal_savings: Fewer main-model input tokens, offset by classifier inference and possible recovery.
adoption_and_rollback: Do not install by default. Use an isolated, consented task-specific trial only after route, rights, privacy and dependencies are cleared. Retain exact originals and compare full-task outcomes including helpers/restores; bypass the candidate and restore the previous pipeline/settings to revert.
authority_maturity: Published study or source-visible project/vendor documentation as specified; evidence strength does not establish compatibility with every native harness.
